summary: Amended the watcher plan to detect .crews roots before Ralph root parsing and route crew events through a dedicated rescanCrewSessionsAndWrite helper instead of deriveAffectedTaskUpdate.
Updated Story 2 and its acceptance criterion to require a top-level schema properties.crewsRoot string entry and validation of configs that set crewsRoot.
Story 2 now explicitly requires resolve-config.mjs to destructure and return crewsRoot, plus a resolver test that verifies crewsRoot overrides resolve to absolute paths.
Updated Story 7 and matching acceptance criteria to use the Ralph sidecar write path and clarify that writeSidecar regenerates the derived snapshot.

Amended the plan to use fallback (crewName, memberName) identity for partial crew-session entries, upgrade them in place when heuristic data later supplies sessionId/transcriptPath, and require test coverage for that race.

Amended the plan to derive heuristic crew-session stage from ralphState.byTaskId[taskId].stage, preserve recorded stage buckets across later task advancement, and require tests for the implementing-to-reviewing case.
Amended Story 2 to explicitly require adding top-level crewsRoot: string to the RalphOverviewConfig interface in scripts/lib/default-config.d.mts.
Updated the cwd-filter contract and test expectations so manifests at the repo root are accepted while prefix-attack paths remain rejected.
Updated the plan so default crewsRoot resolves to the main repo .crews when repoRoot is a linked worktree, with resolver and acceptance-test requirements.
Added explicit cascade-audit requirements to update emit-snapshot-schema.test.mjs with positive crewSessions validation and malformed CrewSessionRef rejection coverage.
Amended the draft plan tmp file to specify the exact .crews mailbox, outbox, and inbox-history chokidar ignore patterns in the watcher/config sections.
